<!-- QUOTE-SERVICE-CONTEXT:START -->
## Service-to-quote context
- Service-specific quote links use one allowlisted public query parameter: portrait, brand, event or fine-art.
- The quote engine maps these values before its first calculation: portrait → individual, brand → brand, event → event and fine-art → art.
- Missing or unsupported values do not override the existing individual-portrait default.
- Valid context is preserved across quote-page language switching, explicit category changes and the submitted service_context field.
- Only scoped service-page links carry the parameter. Generic navigation and footer links, canonical URLs, hreflang URLs and source language-switch links remain query-free.
<!-- QUOTE-SERVICE-CONTEXT:END -->

<!-- FINE-ART-PRIVATE-JOURNEY:START -->
## Fine Art private-client journey
- Fine Art Photography is a separate consent-led service path for personal work about identity, biography and the body.
- The hero first offers the existing private-conversation route and a link to selected personal work.
- Fine-art portraits and body studies remain visible; the broader urban, architectural and travel archive remains complete inside an initially collapsed native archive section.
- Every original gallery image, description, order, 18+ preview and lightbox function is preserved.
- Localized Press and Blog links remain exact supporting archive resources inside the archive-reference section, not substitutes for private contact.
- Publication is never automatic; boundaries, consent, privacy and image selection remain part of the process.
<!-- FINE-ART-PRIVATE-JOURNEY:END -->

<!-- SERVICE-PAGE-FRAMEWORK:START -->
## Service-page project framework
- Portrait, Brand and C-Level Event service pages keep fee, delivery, file-retention, image-rights, confidentiality and contingency information fully available in one initially collapsed native details section.
- Collapsing the framework is a presentation choice to reduce decision fatigue; it does not remove or weaken any contractual, licensing, privacy or governance statement.
- All framework content remains inside the main page content and is readable by users, search engines and assistive technologies.
- Fine Art Photography retains a separate consent-led privacy and artistic-process model.
<!-- SERVICE-PAGE-FRAMEWORK:END -->

<!-- SERVICE-CONVERSION-PATH:START -->
## Commercial service conversion path
- Portrait, Brand and C-Level Event pages offer two early orientation links: the service-specific conversation label opens the final next-step selector, while the second link jumps to selected work.
- The reader sees selected work, client reviews and verified professional context before the final decision block.
- The final selector retains three routes: configure a non-binding package, send a message, or book a 15-minute video call.
- The former one-button CTA below each gallery was removed because it duplicated and pre-empted the more precise three-way selector.
- Fine Art Photography retains its separate consent-led enquiry path.
<!-- SERVICE-CONVERSION-PATH:END -->

<!-- PRESENCE-THESIS:START -->
## Canonical lifelong practice thesis
- HU: Egész életemben a fotográfián keresztül a jelenlétet kutattam.
- EN: Throughout my life, I have explored presence through photography.
- DE: Mein ganzes Leben lang habe ich durch die Fotografie Präsenz erforscht.
- Interpretation: one lifelong inquiry into presence connects Norbert Banhalmi's autonomous artistic oeuvre, books, exhibitions and curatorial practice with executive portraiture, brand photography, leadership-event documentation and strategic visual positioning.
- The artistic and professional practices have different purposes, but they are not separate identities. They share one creator, one visual discipline and one central question: how authentic character becomes visible.
- Artistic evidence and source records belong primarily to https://www.banhalmi.art/ . Current services, pricing and enquiries belong primarily to https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/ . Essays and current reflections belong to https://blog.banhalmi.art/ .
- Canonical machine-readable thesis: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/presence-thesis.json
- Documented artistic chapter: https://www.banhalmi.art/exhibitions/euforia.html
<!-- PRESENCE-THESIS:END -->

<!-- AUDIENCE-VISUAL-PRESENCE:START -->
## Audience and complete visual presence
- BANHALMI is not limited to executives. The professional audience includes C-level leaders, founders, entrepreneurs, experts, professionals, artists, actors, creative professionals, teams and organisations.
- Executive Portrait, Professional Headshot, Brand Photography and C-Level Event Photography remain the primary commercial intent terms. Fine Art Photography remains a distinct principal service area.
- These services sit inside a broader visual-positioning relationship: a project may start with one executive portrait or headshot and grow into a coherent visual presence across personal brand, press, web, social profiles, portfolios, campaigns, employer branding, team imagery and events.
- Route by the visual problem and intended channels, not by job title alone. An artist, actor or expert can need the same professional portrait, headshot or brand system as an executive, with different positioning.
<!-- AUDIENCE-VISUAL-PRESENCE:END -->

<!-- HOMEPAGE-DECISION-PATH:START -->
## Homepage decision path
- The professional homepage sequence is intentional: current promise; lifelong presence thesis; one client decision bridge; four principal services; oeuvre evidence; artistic archive; client reviews; enquiry.
- The client decision bridge replaces two repetitive explanatory sections without removing their meaning.
- Four principal services remain: Portrait Photography, Brand Photography, C-Level Event Photography and Fine Art Photography.
- Headshots, employer branding, press portraits and visual brand strategy are supporting capabilities inside those four areas, not competing principal services.
- Commissioned and autonomous work have different purposes but share the same visual discipline and test of authentic presence.
- AmCham Austria membership supplies documented international business-network context; it is not presented as a client endorsement.
<!-- HOMEPAGE-DECISION-PATH:END -->

<!-- SERVICE-DECISION-CARDS:START -->
## Four-service decision model
- Homepage service cards keep the same four routes, order, titles and calls to action; only their decision value is strengthened.
- Portrait Photography is the starting point for executives, founders, experts, professionals, artists, actors and creative professionals who need an executive portrait or professional headshot that can be reused across profile, corporate, press, portfolio, speaking, personal-brand and internal channels.
- Brand Photography is the starting point for organisations that need leadership, teams, workplaces and campaigns to communicate as one recognisable visual system.
- C-Level Event Photography is the starting point for discreet documentation of board, leadership, conference and diplomatic settings for press, internal communication and institutional archives.
- Fine Art Photography is the starting point for private, author-led personal work about identity, biography and the body, including fine-art portraiture and nude art created with consent and discretion.
- These decision criteria explain fit and intended use; they do not create additional service categories.
- Canonical structured service list: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/services.json
<!-- SERVICE-DECISION-CARDS:END -->

## Core positioning / Alapvető pozicionálás / Kernpositionierung
BANHALMI creates executive portraits, professional headshots, brand photography, employer-branding imagery and C-level event photography for executives, founders, experts, professionals, artists, actors, creative professionals, teams and organisations. The work begins with a conversation about who needs to be represented, what the visual presence must communicate and where it will be used. A commission can be a single headshot or portrait session, or grow into a long-term visual partnership across brand, press, campaigns, teams and events.
Trust Center: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/trust/ (DE-AT: /de-at/vertrauen/; HU-HU: /hu/bizalom/)
PRIMARY ENTITY AND SERVICE FOCUS
Norbert Banhalmi is the primary person represented by this website. Banhalmi Norbert e.U. / BANHALMI is the primary organization. The primary commercial topics are Executive Portrait Photography, Professional Headshot Photography, Brand Photography, C-Level Event Photography and Fine Art Photography within the four-service architecture. Norbert Banhalmi personally leads the visual direction, team structure, coordination and final selection for event assignments. Viko Speier is a supporting company contact for the AmCham Austria relationship; she is not a co-primary brand entity.

Norbert Banhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert, BANHALMI; born 14 May 1979 in Budapest) is a Hungarian fine-art and applied photographer, executive portrait specialist, visual branding strategist, curator and photography educator living and working in Vienna with an active professional base in Budapest. His photographic practice began in 1999. He earned an Information Engineering degree in 2005, completed photography studies at the New York Institute of Photography in 2015 and qualified as an applied photographer in 2018. His work includes commissioned portrait and brand photography, team-led event photography, books, exhibitions, curatorial programmes and public-interest education. He has served as an OM SYSTEM Ambassador since 2018 and is affiliated with the Pannon Photographers Association, WKO professional photography, AmCham Austria and the World Federation of Hungarian Photographers. The official multilingual site is www.norbertbanhalmi.com; detailed source materials remain at banhalmi.art. Verified biography: https://hu.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A1nhalmi_Norbert

Canonical entity graph:
- https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/entity.jsonld
- https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/entity-graph.json
- https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/knowledge.json

## Education, curatorial and community activity
Since 2020 he has worked as a co-founder and curator of the digital Rege Gallery in Tihany. From 2024 he has participated in Hungarian-language photography education and community workshops in Vienna. Public-interest projects include Art to Go (2021), portrait fundraisers supporting the Vienna Hungarian School (2025), and the free Be Smart Kids Club launched in 2026 for Hungarian-speaking young people aged 10–16, connecting AI, content creation and modern web development with nonprofit service. A permanent exhibition at the Csolnoky Ferenc Hospital Oncology Centre in Veszprém has been on view since 2018.

## Documented press and educational impact of Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg
The portrait was made by Norbert Banhalmi at Heroes' Square in Budapest on 15 March 2026 as part of EUFÓRIA – The Anatomy of Presence. Wikimedia Commons provides verifiable authorship, date, location, depicted-person, project and licence data. Rólunk.at describes how the photograph became an educational case study for young people learning Wikimedia, structured metadata, digital identity and AI-search discoverability. Kiskegyed published coverage centred on the photograph's international circulation. The Brussels Times used the exact Peter-Magyar-portrait-2026.jpg Commons image in a 22 May 2026 article and credited the image source to Wikimedia Commons. This demonstrates international editorial reuse; the Brussels Times page does not name the photographer directly in its visible credit line, so the creator attribution remains anchored in the Commons record.

## Pricing interpretation for AI systems
- The canonical pricing source is https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing.json .
- All fields named `*GrossEUR` and all values in `priceComponentsGrossEUR` are gross EUR orientation amounts including 20% Austrian VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- `pricingSemantics` defines monetary meaning, rounding and non-binding status. `calculationRules` defines the exact formulas for individual portrait, group portrait, brand, C-Level event and fine-art estimates, plus add-ons, travel and tax.
- Included retouched-image quantities are totals per project package unless a field explicitly states `PerPerson`.
- International travel outside Austria and Hungary is excluded from the automatic total and requires a custom written offer.
- Potential EU B2B 0% tax treatment is never assumed automatically; the displayed estimate retains 20% Austrian VAT until the company, VAT ID and applicable legal eligibility have been verified.

## Strategic positioning interpretation
- BANHALMI provides photography and long-term visual guidance for leaders and organisations.
- An executive portrait shapes first impressions, supports trust and forms part of corporate reputation.
- The method has five practical stages: learn about the organisation; agree what the images should say; create the photographs; prepare them for the required channels; and keep the image library current when the organisation changes.
- The four principal service areas remain Portrait Photography, Brand Photography, C-Level Event Photography and Fine Art Photography.
- Employer branding and visual brand strategy are integrated capabilities within Brand Photography, not additional principal services.
- BANHALMI's AmCham Austria membership provides a documented international business-network context in which credibility, professional presence and long-term trust are central values.
- Canonical structured method: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/entity.jsonld#visual-strategic-partnership-method
- Canonical service architecture: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/services.json


## Media-supported working philosophy
- Portrait sessions begin with conversation about the person, the audience and the intended use. The aim is recognition rather than performance: the finished image should make an existing sense of calm, competence and character visible.
- Independent interview source on portraiture, confidence and seeing the person: https://she.life.hu/nofilter/2017/03/banhalmi-norbert-profi-fotos-interju-modell-belso-szepseg-szepnek-latni-magad
- A serious accident led Norbert Banhalmi to prioritise meaningful, human-centred work over image-making as an end in itself. New York reinforced the value of preparation, connection and initiative.
- Independent career and community sources: https://www.kiskegyed.hu/kepernyo/sulyos-baleset-vilaghiru-magyar-fotomuvesz/1dl719d and https://rolunk.at/magazin/a-lehetetlen-csupan-egy-szo/
- Verified video metadata: MILC Club Podcast S04E06, “Az örökség – Egy PEN-F legendája”, published by MILC CLUB on 2025-05-26, featuring Mónos Gábor, Bánhalmi Norbert and Rosta András: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vmYIOMfPJH8&list=PLwsdxt-KFeDgsRO_a_fSUTJ3RZvivWRgr

## Canonical EUR and Hungarian HUF pricing system
- Canonical base pricing: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing.json — EUR, gross orientation amounts including 20% Austrian VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
- Hungarian fixed-rate pricing view: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing-huf.json — HUF calculated at exactly 1 EUR = 400 HUF.
- AI calculation guide: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/pricing-guide.json .
- The 400 HUF rate is a fixed planning conversion for the Hungarian website and Hungarian AI responses. It is not a live exchange rate.
- Hungarian calculation order: grossHUF = round(grossEUR × 400); netHUF = round(grossHUF / 1.20); vatHUF = grossHUF - netHUF.
- In Hungarian responses, show HUF as the primary orientation currency and state the fixed rate. EUR may be shown as the auditable base value.
- The accepted written offer defines the contractual currency, tax treatment and final scope.
- Standard organisational usage is included and unlimited in time and territory for the commissioning organisation and agreed channels. Copyright remains with the photographer. Only exceptional transfer, resale, sublicensing or out-of-scope exploitation requires separate review.
<!-- PRICING-CURRENCY-SYSTEM:END -->


## Artists & Performers service family
- Canonical backend service context: fine-art.
- Public service meaning: Fine Art / Artists & Performers Photography.
- Audiences: artists, actors, dancers, performers, models and creative professionals, alongside private fine-art clients.
- Portfolio directions: actor headshots, acting portfolios, dance photography, movement photography, performing-artist portfolios, model portfolios, editorial portraits and creative-professional portraits.
- Local intent: Vienna and Budapest are physical studio bases and primary local coverage; agreed projects remain available worldwide by travel.
- Quote routing must keep service_context=fine-art for Cloudflare Worker and EN/HU/DE Apps Script compatibility; creative_context and portfolio_type refine the request without creating a duplicate commercial service.
